"Automates forget → restart → reconnect when Thor Wi-Fi gets stuck. This is a firmware workaround.

Connect keeps Android networks. Recovery forgets ALL Android networks after confirmation, then reconnects the selected profile. The app list and passwords are kept. “Connected ✓” means association and an IP address; Internet access is not tested.

WPA2-PSK and WPA3-SAE are detected automatically from scans. Wi-Fi 7 is a radio generation: this app cannot turn the Thor into a Wi-Fi 7 device. A Wi-Fi 7 router may accept it in a compatible mode. Hidden, Enterprise and open networks are unsupported. Passwords: 8–63 printable ASCII characters.

The list syncs with Downloads / Thor-Scripts / WIFI_RESEAUX.txt. That file stores passwords in plain text. Edit / Delete manages this list without forgetting Android networks.

Version 2.4 · AYN root service required. All scripts are bundled in the APK. No PC, Shizuku or Internet required after installation. Keep the app installed, avoid force-stop, and unlock after restart if prompted. FR / EN changes the language."
